preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Contract must have accumulated TeaToken balance from fees

exploit_hint: As owner, call setTaxFeePercent(0) and setLiquidityFeePercent(0) to disable fees, then transfer tokens from contract to owner address. Alternatively, manipulate swapAndLiquifyEnabled and maxTxAmount to prevent fee collection while allowing owner transfers. Use excludeFromFee(owner) to avoid paying fees on transfers.
